users.name: Brgy. Bugo Admin
users.address: Barangay Bugo Administrative Complex, Cagayan de Oro City

programs.title: Business Permit Endorsement
programs.tagline: Barangay commercial clearance endorsement required for City Hall Mayor’s Business Permit.
programs.description: Administrative assessment and environmental clearance inspection for sari-sari stores, retail enterprises, food stalls, and commercial establishments operating within Bugo.
requirements: DTI Business Name Registration or SEC Certificate
Lease Contract or Proof of Property Ownership
Fire Safety Inspection and Sanitation Endorsement
eligibilityCriteria: Business establishment located within Barangay Bugo
Compliance with local zoning and environmental waste disposal ordinances

programs.title: First-Time Job Seeker Certification
programs.tagline: Republic Act 11261 waiver granting 100% free government clearances and certificates for new graduates.
programs.description: Under the First-Time Jobseekers Assistance Act, this certification waives fees for NBI Clearance, Police Clearance, Barangay Clearance, Medical Certificates, and Birth Certificates when seeking first-time employment.
requirements: School Diploma, Transcript, or Certificate of Graduation
Barangay Resident ID or Proof of Bugo Address
Signed Oath of Undertaking for First-Time Job Seekers
eligibilityCriteria: First-time entrant to the formal job market
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Certificate of Good Moral Character
programs.tagline: Attestation of good civic behavior, community standing, and law-abiding citizenship.
programs.description: Documentary proof required by universities, scholarship foundations, security agencies, and prospective employers confirming the applicant possesses exemplary community conduct.
requirements: Valid Government ID
Barangay Clearance copy
2 Character Reference sign-offs from neighbors or Purok Officer
eligibilityCriteria: Clean barangay record with no administrative sanctions or peace violations
Verified resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Certificate of Indigency
programs.tagline: Affidavit of indigent economic status for legal aid, medical fee waivers, and government relief.
programs.description: Free official certification confirming that the family belongs to the low-income bracket. Used to request medical subsidy at Northern Mindanao Medical Center (NMMC), JR Borja General Hospital, PAO legal services, and DSWD assistance.
requirements: Valid Resident ID or Voter Certification
Endorsement from Purok / Zone Chairman
Affidavit of Low Income or Certificate of Non-Filing of ITR
eligibilityCriteria: Household monthly income at or below statutory poverty threshold
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Certificate of Residency
programs.tagline: Formal proof of physical residence within the territorial jurisdiction of Barangay Bugo.
programs.description: Official certification verifying that the individual currently resides in a specific Purok/Zone of Bugo. Commonly needed for court filings, electric/water utility meter applications, and school enrollments.
requirements: Valid Government ID with Bugo address
Purok Leader Endorsement / Sitio Clearance
Proof of Billing or House Rental Contract
eligibilityCriteria: Currently living in Barangay Bugo
Minimum residence duration of 3 months

programs.title: Issuance of Barangay Clearance
programs.tagline: Official certification certifying residency, good character, and clean barangay record.
programs.description: Universal administrative document required for employment, passport application, bank account opening, postal ID, and government transactions in Cagayan de Oro City.
requirements: Valid Government ID or Student ID
Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
Proof of Residency (Zone 1 to 10 of Bugo)
eligibilityCriteria: Bona fide resident of Barangay Bugo for at least 6 months
Verified Barangay Bugo resident in good community standing

programs.title: PWD Barangay Endorsement & Certification (RA 10754)
programs.tagline: Official certification endorsing Persons with Disabilities for National PWD ID and discounts.
programs.description: Official attestation confirming the applicant has a permanent physical, sensory, or psychosocial impairment and resides in Bugo. Required for City Social Welfare PWD ID card issuance and 20% discount booklet.
requirements: Medical Certificate with Disability Assessment from a licensed physician
Barangay Resident ID or Proof of Bugo Address
2 copies 2x2 recent ID photos
eligibilityCriteria: Diagnosed with physical, sensory, cognitive, or psychological disability
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Senior Citizen Barangay Endorsement & Certification
programs.tagline: Formal endorsement and certification of elderly status for OSCA ID and social pension benefits.
programs.description: Barangay certification attesting that the resident is aged 60 and above, residing within Bugo. Used for OSCA Booklet issuance, PhilHealth senior lifetime membership, and local birthday cash gifts.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate or Proof of Age (60 years old and above)
Barangay Resident ID Card or Voter Certification
2 copies 2x2 recent ID photos
eligibilityCriteria: Filipino citizen residing in Barangay Bugo
Must be 60 years of age or older

programs.title: Solo Parent Barangay Certification (RA 11861)
programs.tagline: Official certification certifying Solo Parent status under the Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act.
programs.description: Mandatory certificate needed to claim the ₱1,000 monthly city cash subsidy, 7-day parental leave, education scholarship priorities, and government relief for solo mothers and fathers.
programs.targetAudience: Solo / Single Parents Parenting Dependents in Bugo
requirements: Affidavit of Solo Parenting (detailing abandonment, separation, or widowhood)
Birth Certificate of dependent children (unmarried & below 22)
Valid Government ID or Barangay Resident ID
eligibilityCriteria: Sole financial and physical custody of minor or dependent children
Registered resident of Barangay Bugo
Household income not exceeding statutory threshold

programs.title: Student Barangay Certification & Fee Waiver Endorsement
programs.tagline: Official certification certifying active student status for fee waivers and academic grants.
programs.description: Documentary certification required by tertiary institutions, TESDA academies, and CHED scholarship boards to verify active student residency in Bugo for student fare discounts and educational stipends.
programs.targetAudience: Elementary, High School, College, & Vocational Students
requirements: Valid School ID or Certificate of Registration (COR)
Barangay Resident ID or Proof of Address
Latest Report Card or Transcript of Records
eligibilityCriteria: Currently enrolled in an accredited public or private school/college
Bona fide resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Birth Certificate Registration Assistance
programs.tagline: Timely registration assistance for newborns born within Barangay Bugo to the City Civil Registry.
programs.description: Guidance and document verification for Certificate of Live Birth (COLB) within the standard 30-day statutory period. Prevents late registration penalties and ensures accurate legal identity.
requirements: Certificate of Live Birth signed by Doctor or Midwife
Marriage Certificate of Parents (if married)
Affidavit of Admission of Paternity (if unmarried)
Valid IDs of both Parents
eligibilityCriteria: Child born in Barangay Bugo or parents residing in Bugo
Submitted within 30 days of child birth

programs.title: Death Registration Assistance
programs.tagline: Certificate of Death processing, municipal cemetery burial clearance, and mortuary assistance.
programs.description: Expedited processing of Certificate of Death with the local civil registrar, issuance of barangay burial permit, and coordination with local cemeteries and mortuary financial aid programs.
requirements: Certificate of Death signed by attending physician or City Health Officer
Valid ID of Informant / Immediate Family Member
Barangay Certificate of Residency of the deceased
eligibilityCriteria: Deceased was a resident of Barangay Bugo or passing occurred in Bugo
Authorized surviving relative filing report

programs.title: Late Birth Registration Assistance
programs.tagline: Delayed birth registration endorsements, negative PSA certificate verification, and affidavits.
programs.description: Legal document assistance for individuals whose births were never registered with the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA). Essential for obtaining National ID, passports, and school enrollment.
requirements: PSA Negative Certification of Birth
Joint Affidavit of Two Disinterested Persons who witnessed birth
Baptismal Certificate or Elementary School Form 137
Barangay Certificate of Residency
eligibilityCriteria: Born in Barangay Bugo without an existing PSA birth record
Resident of Bugo

programs.title: Marriage Registration Assistance
programs.tagline: Pre-marriage counseling compliance, marriage license filing, and Kasalang Bayan coordination.
programs.description: Assistance for engaged couples seeking civil marriage license documentation, compliance with Pre-Marriage Orientation and Counseling (PMOC), and enrollment in mass wedding ceremonies.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificates of both partners
Certificate of No Marriage Record (CENOMAR) from PSA
Pre-Marriage Counseling (PMC) Certificate
Barangay Certificate of Residency for both parties
eligibilityCriteria: At least one party must be a legal resident of Barangay Bugo
Legal capacity to contract marriage under Philippine Family Code

programs.title: Scholarship Assistance and Inquiries
programs.tagline: Barangay Bugo College Financial Grant and facilitation of Cagayan de Oro City College scholarships.
programs.description: Semester cash subsidy providing tuition and textbook support to deserving tertiary, vocational (TESDA), and senior high school students maintaining passing academic records.
requirements: Certificate of Registration (COR) / Enrollment Form
Certificate of Indigency from Barangay Bugo
Valid School ID
Latest Semester Grades (GWA 83% or above with no failing grades)
eligibilityCriteria: Enrolled in an accredited CHED/TESDA university or technical institute
Household monthly income not exceeding ₱15,000.00
Resident of Barangay Bugo for at least 1 year

programs.title: Community Programs and Activities
programs.tagline: Youth SK basketball leagues, coastal clean-ups, tree planting, and cultural fiesta celebrations.
programs.description: Civic enrichment activities promoting environmental sustainability, community solidarity, sports development, anti-drug awareness seminars, and vibrant cultural festivities in Barangay Bugo.
programs.targetAudience: Youth, SK Members, Families, & Civic Groups
requirements: Barangay Resident ID or SK Youth Registration Form
Signed event participant waiver (for sports events)
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Open to all community members

programs.title: Disaster Preparedness and Response
programs.tagline: BDRRMC typhoon monitoring, flood alert sirens, emergency rescue dispatch, and risk mapping.
programs.description: Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (BDRRMC) 24/7 command operation coordinating emergency communications, flood monitoring for Bugo river waterways, and swift water rescue dispatch.
programs.targetAudience: All Bugo Puroks, Coastal & Riverine Zones
requirements: Emergency location and contact person
Nature of emergency (Flood, Landslide, Fire, Medical)
eligibilityCriteria: Any emergency or disaster incident within Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Evacuation Assistance
programs.tagline: Pre-emptive evacuation transport, shelter management, hot meals, and family reunification.
programs.description: Organized emergency vehicles and designated Bugo evacuation shelters (Bugo Covered Court, Bugo Central School) equipped with emergency generator sets, sleeping cots, sanitation, and relief supply storage.
requirements: Purok location & number of vulnerable family members (Infants, PWD, Seniors)
eligibilityCriteria: Families threatened by floodwaters, typhoon storm surge, or fire

programs.title: Community Safety and Security Coordination
programs.tagline: 24/7 Barangay Tanod patrols, night security escorts, curfew monitoring, and police coordination.
programs.description: Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team (BPAT) conducting motorized mobile patrols, maintaining peace in commercial alleys, securing public transport hubs, and deterring nighttime criminal activity.
requirements: Incident location / Purok
Caller identity or anonymous security alert details
eligibilityCriteria: Applies to all public and residential sectors of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Basic Health Checkups
programs.tagline: Routine blood pressure monitoring, random blood sugar screening, and vital signs assessment.
programs.description: Preventive cardiovascular and metabolic health screenings conducted by barangay health workers (BHWs). Early detection for hypertension, diabetes, and lifestyle illnesses.
requirements: Valid Resident ID or Senior Citizen ID
Personal Health Monitoring Logbook (optional)
eligibilityCriteria: Open to all residents of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Circumcision Services
programs.tagline: Annual free minor surgical circumcision (Operation Tuli) with sterile equipment and antibiotic kit.
programs.description: Safe clinical circumcision performed by registered medical doctors and nurses during summer breaks. Includes free local anesthesia, sterile surgical sets, post-op antibiotics, and dressing kits.
requirements: Signed Parental Consent and Waiver Form
Child Birth Certificate or Student ID
Parent / Guardian Valid Resident ID
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo aged 9 years old and above
No bleeding disorders or contraindicating medical conditions

programs.title: Free Medical Consultations
programs.tagline: Walk-in and scheduled medical consultations with Bugo Health Center physicians and nurses.
programs.description: Comprehensive general outpatient clinical consultations, physical examinations, vital checks, prescription generation, and diagnostic referrals provided at zero cost to residents.
requirements: Barangay Resident ID or Family Health Card
Previous Medical Records / Prescriptions (if any)
eligibilityCriteria: Registered resident of Barangay Bugo
Non-emergency outpatient medical needs

programs.title: Dental Services and Tooth Extraction
programs.tagline: Free tooth extraction, oral health consultation, fluoride treatment, and emergency relief.
programs.description: Visiting City Health Dentist clinics providing dental checkups, tooth extractions for decayed teeth, pain relief medication, and pediatric fluoride varnishing for Bugo youth.
requirements: Valid Barangay Resident ID or School ID
Blood pressure screening prior to extraction
Signed Medical History / Consent Form
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Clinically cleared for dental extraction

programs.title: Family Planning Services
programs.tagline: Responsible parenthood counseling, oral contraceptives, DMPA injectables, and IUD insertion referrals.
programs.description: Free reproductive health education, supply of oral contraceptive pills, condoms, quarterly injectable DMPA, and referrals for bilateral tubal ligation and vasectomy.
programs.targetAudience: Couples and Individuals of Reproductive Age
requirements: Family Planning Client Card / Resident ID
Brief health assessment with midwife
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Voluntary enrollment in family planning methods

programs.title: Free Medicines (Subject to Availability)
programs.tagline: Free pharmacy dispensing of maintenance medicines, antibiotics, and vitamins.
programs.description: Barangay Bugo health dispensary stocks vital medications for hypertension (Losartan, Amlodipine), diabetes (Metformin), pediatric antibiotics, paracetamol, and vitamins sourced from City Health Department.
requirements: Valid Doctor’s Prescription (issued within the last 60 days)
Barangay Resident ID or Indigency Slip
Senior Citizen OSCA ID or PWD ID (for maintenance)
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Valid doctor prescription matching pharmacy inventory

programs.title: Immunization and Vaccination
programs.tagline: National Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) vaccines for infants, toddlers, and seniors.
programs.description: Complete childhood vaccine protection including BCG, Hepatitis B, Pentavalent, Oral Polio, Measles-Rubella, as well as annual seasonal Flu and Pneumococcal vaccines for senior citizens.
programs.deadline: Wednesdays: Infant EPI | Seasonal: Senior Flu
requirements: Child Baby Health Book / Immunization Card
Parent or Guardian Valid Resident ID
Senior Citizen ID (for Senior Flu shots)
eligibilityCriteria: Age-appropriate vaccine schedule under DOH guidelines
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Maternal and Prenatal Care
programs.tagline: Safe motherhood prenatal checkups, tetanus toxoid, iron supplements, and birth planning.
programs.description: Comprehensive maternal health services supporting expectant mothers through every trimester. Includes fetal heartbeat monitoring, prenatal vitamins, laboratory referrals, and delivery facility coordination.
requirements: Mother & Child Health Book (Pink Card)
Valid ID of Expectant Mother
Previous ultrasound or laboratory findings (if available)
eligibilityCriteria: Pregnant resident residing in Bugo Zones 1-10
Commitment to regular prenatal follow-ups

programs.title: Nutrition Programs
programs.tagline: Supplementary feeding for malnourished children, micronutrient powders, and growth monitoring.
programs.description: Barangay Nutrition Scholar (BNS) program conducting Operation Timbang Plus, hot nutritious daily meal feeding for wasted/stunted toddlers, and vitamin A supplementation.
requirements: Child Growth Monitoring Record
Parent Resident ID
Barangay Health Center Indigency slip
eligibilityCriteria: Children aged 6 to 59 months identified as underweight or stunted
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Tuberculosis (TB-DOTS) Services
programs.tagline: Free sputum microscopy, GeneXpert testing, chest X-ray vouchers, and full 6-month anti-TB treatment.
programs.description: Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course (TB-DOTS) clinic providing confidential diagnosis, daily medication management, and contact tracing to eradicate tuberculosis in the community.
requirements: Sputum specimen for laboratory examination
Valid Resident ID
Chest X-Ray referral film (if existing)
eligibilityCriteria: Presumptive TB cases or confirmed positive TB patients
Commitment to complete 6-month regimen

programs.title: Legal Consultation
programs.tagline: Confidential legal advice on civil disputes, family relations, property rights, and labor rights.
programs.description: Free initial legal consultations with visiting volunteer attorneys and paralegals. Get expert counsel on land tenure issues, child custody, domestic violence, debt settlement, and labor exploitation.
requirements: Barangay Resident ID
Summary narrative of legal issue
Copies of relevant contracts, affidavits, or legal documents
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Unable to afford private legal representation

programs.title: Assistance with Legal Documents
programs.tagline: Drafting assistance for Affidavits of Loss, Undertakings, Special Power of Attorney, and Certifications.
programs.description: Barangay paralegal desk assists residents in properly formatting and drafting standard legal affidavits required for lost IDs, SIM registration, school undertakings, and senior pension claims.
programs.targetAudience: All Residents in Need of Legal Templates
requirements: Valid Resident ID
Details of lost item (ID number, date lost, circumstance) or transaction
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Affidavit must be truthful and compliant with Philippine law

programs.title: Free Notarization During Government Outreach
programs.tagline: Pro-bono notarization of affidavits of loss, indigency, parental consent, and undertakings.
programs.description: Regular legal outreach clinics conducted in partnership with the Public Attorney’s Office (PAO) and the Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) offering free notarial seals for low-income constituents.
requirements: Unsigned Document / Affidavit in 2 duplicate copies
Two (2) Valid Government IDs with photo and signature
Barangay Certificate of Indigency
eligibilityCriteria: Document strictly for personal or indigent assistance use
Bona fide resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Agricultural Assistance
programs.tagline: Technical farming extension, organic fertilizer access, and soil fertility advisory.
programs.description: Programs supporting hillside and lowland farmers in Bugo Zones 3, 6, and 7 with sustainable farming techniques, pest management consultations, and organic compost distribution.
requirements: RSBSA (Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture) ID or Registration
Barangay Certificate of Residency
Proof of Farm Land Stewardship or Tillage
eligibilityCriteria: Active farmer or agrarian beneficiary in Bugo
Practicing crop cultivation or livestock raising

programs.title: Business Permit Processing Assistance
programs.tagline: Technical guidance for micro-enterprises on DTI registration, BIR TIN, and business compliance.
programs.description: Consultation desk helping local entrepreneurs, market vendors, and sari-sari store owners navigate regulatory permits, BMBE (Barangay Micro Business Enterprise) tax exemptions, and food handling certificates.
requirements: Proposed Business Name and Location
Valid Resident ID of Business Owner
Sketch of Business Location within Bugo
eligibilityCriteria: Business located within Barangay Bugo
Filipino citizen enterprise owner

programs.title: Employment Referrals
programs.tagline: Direct endorsement to Cagayan de Oro industrial locators, Del Monte cannery, and local businesses.
programs.description: Barangay PESO coordinator endorsements connecting verified local residents directly with hiring managers at food processing plants, logistics centers, supermarkets, and industrial zones in Bugo.
requirements: Updated Resume / Curriculum Vitae
Barangay Clearance for Employment
Police or NBI Clearance
TESDA NC II Certificate (for technical roles)
eligibilityCriteria: Bona fide resident of Barangay Bugo
Meets educational and physical criteria of hiring partner

programs.title: Livelihood and Farming Support
programs.tagline: Livelihood starter kits, food processing training, and cooperative financing linkups.
programs.description: Empowers low-income families and women cooperatives with vocational livelihood skills (meat processing, pastry baking, soap making, swine raising) and small starter grants to achieve sustainable household incomes.
requirements: Certificate of Indigency or Low Income
Barangay Resident ID
Livelihood Group or Cooperative Membership Form
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo
Demonstrated willingness to maintain livelihood enterprise

programs.title: Job Application Assistance
programs.tagline: Free resume encoding and printing, PESO registration, and government clearance preparation.
programs.description: Empower job hunters with professional CV formatting, digital portal applications, PhilJobNet profile registration, and document compilation to fast-track employment.
requirements: Draft biodata or educational records
Barangay Resident ID
2x2 Formal ID Picture
eligibilityCriteria: Resident of Barangay Bugo seeking active employment
At least 18 years of age (or 15-17 with special permit)

programs.title: Distribution of Agricultural Seeds
programs.tagline: Free high-yield certified vegetable seed packets for backyard gardening and food security.
programs.description: Barangay and Department of Agriculture partnership providing seed packs of eggplant (talong), tomato (kamatis), bitter gourd (ampalaya), string beans (sitaw), and okra to promote household food self-sufficiency.
requirements: Barangay Resident ID
Backyard Food Security Pledge Commitment
eligibilityCriteria: Open to all Bugo households with space for gardening or container farming

programs.title: Financial and Medical Assistance Referrals
programs.tagline: Official social case study and endorsement for DSWD AICS, City Mayor’s Office, and PCSO funds.
programs.description: Fast-track endorsement for emergency cash assistance to cover hospitalization bills, dialysis sessions, chemotherapy, specialized laboratory scans, and funeral expenses through government safety nets.
requirements: Original Clinical Abstract or Doctor’s Prescription
Hospital Billing Statement or Funeral Contract
Barangay Certificate of Indigency
Valid Government ID of Applicant & Patient
eligibilityCriteria: Indigent patient or dependent residing in Barangay Bugo
Active medical treatment or recent bereavement

programs.title: Assistance for Low-Income Families
programs.tagline: Emergency grocery subsidies, calamity relief packs, and social protection safety nets.
programs.description: Direct distribution of staple foods (rice, canned goods, milk), seasonal assistance, and targeted interventions for ultra-poor families residing in informal settlements across Bugo.
requirements: Barangay Indigency Certification
Family Composition & Purok Registration
Valid Resident ID
eligibilityCriteria: Household monthly income below ₱8,500.00
Bona fide family resident of Bugo

programs.title: Assistance for Persons with Disabilities (PWD)
programs.tagline: PWD ID issuance, 20% discount booklets, assistive mobility devices, and quarterly welfare aid.
programs.description: Advocacy and benefits program protecting Bugo residents with long-term physical, mental, intellectual, or sensory impairments under Republic Act 10754.
requirements: Medical Certificate with Disability Assessment from licensed physician
Barangay Certificate of Residency in Bugo
2 copies of 2x2 ID photos with white background
eligibilityCriteria: Diagnosed with permanent physical, cognitive, visual, hearing, or psychological disability
Resident of Barangay Bugo

programs.title: Assistance for Senior Citizens
programs.tagline: Office of Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) booklet, social pensions, and centenarian benefits.
programs.description: Comprehensive welfare facilitation for elderly residents aged 60 and above. Includes OSCA identification cards, 20% discount booklets, facilitation of DSWD Social Pension for indigent seniors, and annual local cash gifts.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate or Valid ID showing Birthdate (Age 60+)
Barangay Certificate of Residency in Bugo
2 copies of 2x2 recent ID photos
eligibilityCriteria: Filipino citizen residing in Barangay Bugo
Must be 60 years of age or older

programs.title: Solo Parent Assistance
programs.tagline: Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act (RA 11861) ID processing, ₱1,000 monthly cash subsidy, and leave benefits.
programs.description: Registration and support for single mothers and fathers parenting dependents alone. Grants access to 7-day parental leave, education scholarships, and priority in government housing and livelihood assistance.
programs.targetAudience: Single Parents & Legal Guardians in Bugo
requirements: Affidavit of Solo Parenting detailing circumstance (abandonment, separation, death)
Birth Certificate of dependent child/children (below 22 years old if unmarried/unemployed)
Death Certificate of spouse (if applicable)
Barangay Indigency or Income Tax Return
eligibilityCriteria: Sole custody and financial provider for minor or dependent children
Resident of Barangay Bugo for at least 6 months

programs.title: Wheelchair Assistance
programs.tagline: Free donation of orthopedic wheelchairs, walkers, and crutches for mobility-impaired residents.
programs.description: Direct provision of mobility aids procured through barangay health development funds and civic organization donations to restore independence to bedridden, senior, and injured Bugo constituents.
programs.targetAudience: Paraplegic, Amputee, and Frail Elderly Residents
requirements: Physician recommendation for mobility aid
Barangay Indigency Certification
PWD ID or Senior ID of recipient
eligibilityCriteria: Documented medical requirement for wheelchair or walking aid
Low-income resident of Barangay Bugo unable to purchase privately
